info.name: PF-004 Seed Data Validation
info.description:
Tests all 5 acceptance criteria for PF-004 seed script.
Base URL: http://localhost:8000
All seed accounts use password: Test1234!

Workflow:
1. Run 'Health Check' first
2. Login with each role (T01–T05)
3. Use 'Set Token' steps to store access_token in collection variable
4. Run protected endpoint tests

Protected — GET /me (per role)
item.description: Tests GET /api/v1/auth/me with each role. Each request logs in first via pre-request script, then calls /me.

item.name: Logout — Per Role
item.description: Tests POST /api/v1/auth/logout for each role. Each sub-flow: login → logout → verify refresh token revoked.

item.name: L04 /me after logout — 200 (JWT still valid until expiry)

exec: // JWT access tokens are stateless — logout only revokes the refresh token.
// The access token remains valid until JWT_EXPIRY_MINUTES (60 min).
// This is expected behavior: the real logout proof is L03 (refresh → 401).
pm.test('Status 200 — access token still valid', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: L11 Logout with invalid refresh_token → 200 (no info leak)

exec: // Logout always returns 200 to prevent token enumeration.
// Uses the already-revoked refreshToken from L09/L10
// Logout is idempotent — always returns 200 even if already revoked.
